source_sync.preserved_differences: Existing additional NVL workflow steps and user documentation preserved by three-way merge. Untouched legacy helpers, stricter extraction and private-file exclusions remain in the user source tree. Runtime code is checked separately against the production commit.
source_sync.timing: Source snapshots verified before post-build documentation updates. Runtime, ABI and kernel sources remain identical; the user archive also contains subsequent documentation and supplemental research.

supplemental_local_research.scope: Complete original entries with synthetic MSR, topology/mask and delay boundaries. No real CPU enumeration or I/O.
findings: The named perfbias entries read/write MSR 48 bit 1, not MSR 1B0 energy performance bias.
One MSR sample is copied to every synthetic target, preserving that sample rather than each target register.
The 64-bit target mask is truncated through EAX -> ECX before WrmsrTx.
Wrapper failures are ignored; untouched read outputs become zero, then setters broadcast that value.
No capability check, per-target old-value comparison or readback occurs in these entries.
supplemental_local_research.validation: Additional local Python/Unicorn research; not part of the production CI counts

visual_review.scope: Manually reviewed BCLK adaptive voltage, PL4, Intel energy/HWP capability/history fixtures on Debian 11 and EL7. Checked displayed values/units, read-only fields, confirmation outcomes and full register values.
visual_review.capture_limit: Only these six native fixture screenshots were manually reviewed; other saved images were checked for presence. Narrower telemetry screenshots elide the tail of the State column; the full text is covered by Qt/clipboard checks.

superseded_attempts.reason: Linux/CLI succeeded; Windows test bool/integer warnings fixed and HWP status history added.
Core and CLI passed; superseded by shared PL4 implementation, portability cancelled by new push.

limits: EL7 means the tested Oracle Linux 7.9 x86_64 target, not all RHEL/CentOS 7 machines
EL7 uses its own Qt/GUI/CLI baseline with system GLIBC 2.17; native GCC builds the 3.10 module
BCLK adaptive voltage and PL4 writes are scoped to Intel family 6 model B7 bare metal; no hardware effect measurement
Energy counters cover B7 package/PP0 and 8F/CF package/DRAM; DRAM requires BIOS RAPL mode 0 and measured power remains unvalidated
Architectural HWP 777h history flags are read-only and not current performance indicators
Configuration readback is not proof of hardware effects; live events may reassert after clearing
ICCmax/VR mapping, Vmax, extended TVB, remaining AMD/board protocols and physical hardware/Secure Boot acceptance remain pending
Windows/macOS checks validate the portable core, not a complete OS hardware backend
